commits.subject: Open subagent transcripts in the TUI sidebar (#62157)
commits.reason: Keep the parent transcript visible while reading its subagent. Preserve ALab's actual Side-conversation owner, frame input hold and guarded thread selection during focus, close and restore.
evidence: Reviewed the exact parent-to-commit patch, SHA256 06e67d10016dde06858904312b4957909a3891bfde932431914a5ee71819b97f.
The docked tab is associated with the primary thread. Parent-owned subagents use transcript navigation, search and selection in the watch-only view.
Escape returns to the owning chooser and keeps the agent selected. A failed attachment restores the original sidebar content, and successful replacement retires the prior companion.
commits.revisit: Run the watch-only transcript integration control with native Side companions, saved drafts, resize and focus before and after handoff.

commits.subject: Open subagent transcripts from activity links in the TUI (#62159)
commits.reason: Open a subagent from a parent activity link only after the original backend confirms ancestry. Keep ALab's backend routing and native input-admission boundaries on the new event.
evidence: Reviewed the exact parent-to-commit patch, SHA256 0a281ebe520c738ce2c19edc980d8b2f16a83e30c5e07ba7c7b5eb5ff75d5230.

Replay may register a candidate, but backend discovery or a live thread source is required to confirm membership. The pending click carries its backend and source and is cleared when the connection is replaced or the thread selection changes.
The event rechecks source visibility, primary root and backend; the expanded fixture covers an inherited fork link, discovery racing the click, and a nested link from an unfocused pane.
commits.revisit: Run the link fixtures with ALab retained Side and parallel backend state, including ownership replacement while discovery is pending.

commits.subject: Wait for the system `bwrap` probe with a pidfd (#62160)
commits.reason: Let Linux observe system bubblewrap probe exit through the child's pidfd while preserving the bounded fallback and the existing sandbox decision.
evidence: Reviewed the exact parent-to-commit patch, SHA256 97e09a5cde9d0c9fb5a4a0821266bcff97635492ef28152e112a3027250ef27a.
The pidfd is scoped to the spawned child and polled only for the time remaining. The existing try_wait loop still reaps the child, handles unavailable pidfds and applies the deadline.
Captured stderr remains nonblocking and size-bounded, including when a descendant retains the pipe. The existing stderr classifier and sandbox selection are unchanged.
commits.revisit: Exercise the Linux probe controls for early exit with inherited stderr and timeouts, then check the older-kernel fallback.
